name: agent-reach
title: agent-reach
description: Free, local, read-only access to platform content: search and read posts, comments, subtitles, stock quotes and jobs across X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Instagram, Facebook, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili and more — no API keys for public content.
why: The free/local fetch layer the research cluster lacked: its fetchers are the paid ScrapeCreators API (credit-limited) and exa-search, and no entry reads platforms like Xiaohongshu and Bilibili at all. Fetch here, analyze with the cluster’s existing skills.
adaptations: English skill file used as the canonical SKILL.md (upstream SKILL_en.md); the three references/*.md were translated faithfully from Chinese to English for the collection’s English-only rule; every command, flag, path and JSON field is unchanged from upstream.
